INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, match_stage, score)
SELECT user_id, product_id, 'sql', score
FROM (
  SELECT u.user_id, p.product_id,
         ROUND(100 - COALESCE(p.interest_rate, 20), 2) AS score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY u.user_id
           ORDER BY COALESCE(p.interest_rate, 20) ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM users u
  JOIN loan_products p ON p.is_active
  WHERE u.batch_id = $1::uuid
    AND (p.min_income       IS NULL OR u.monthly_income >= p.min_income)
    AND (p.min_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score  >= p.min_credit_score)
    AND (p.max_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score  <= p.max_credit_score)
    AND (p.min_age          IS NULL OR u.age >= p.min_age)
    AND (p.max_age          IS NULL OR u.age <= p.max_age)
    AND (p.employment_status IS NULL OR (CASE lower(trim(u.employment_status)) WHEN 'salaried professional' THEN 'salaried' WHEN 'self employed' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'self employed professional' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'self-employed professional' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'business owner' THEN 'business' WHEN 'entrepreneur' THEN 'business' ELSE lower(trim(u.employment_status)) END) = ANY(p.employment_status))
    AND (NOT p.needs_llm_check OR ((p.min_income IS NULL OR u.monthly_income >= p.min_income * 1.2) AND (p.min_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score + 25)))
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING match_id, user_id, product_id;

INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, match_stage, score)
SELECT x.user_id::uuid, x.product_id, 'llm', 75
FROM json_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.pairs) }}'::json)
     AS x(user_id text, product_id bigint)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING match_id;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.criteria_text,
       (ROUND(u.monthly_income / 25000) * 25000)::int AS income_band,
       (ROUND(u.credit_score / 50.0) * 50)::int       AS score_band,
       (CASE lower(trim(u.employment_status)) WHEN 'salaried professional' THEN 'salaried' WHEN 'self employed' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'self employed professional' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'self-employed professional' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'business owner' THEN 'business' WHEN 'entrepreneur' THEN 'business' ELSE lower(trim(u.employment_status)) END) AS employment,
       array_agg(u.user_id)                           AS user_ids,
       count(*)                                       AS users_in_profile
FROM users u
JOIN loan_products p ON p.is_active AND p.needs_llm_check
WHERE u.batch_id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid
  AND (p.min_income       IS NULL OR u.monthly_income >= p.min_income)
  AND (p.min_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score  >= p.min_credit_score)
  AND (p.max_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score  <= p.max_credit_score)
  AND (p.min_age          IS NULL OR u.age >= p.min_age)
  AND (p.max_age          IS NULL OR u.age <= p.max_age)
  AND (p.employment_status IS NULL OR (CASE lower(trim(u.employment_status)) WHEN 'salaried professional' THEN 'salaried' WHEN 'self employed' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'self employed professional' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'self-employed professional' THEN 'self-employed' WHEN 'business owner' THEN 'business' WHEN 'entrepreneur' THEN 'business' ELSE lower(trim(u.employment_status)) END) = ANY(p.employment_status))
AND NOT ((p.min_income IS NULL OR u.monthly_income >= p.min_income * 1.2) AND (p.min_credit_score IS NULL OR u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score + 25))
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.criteria_text, 4, 5, 6
ORDER BY users_in_profile DESC
LIMIT 40;
